items: Removed the Book object from Main class (we will add it inside the Issue class).

blocks.content: Inside the Issue class, we have created the object of Book class. Then, we created a constructor of the Issue class which we have called the add() method of the Book class.
Now, whenever we create an object of the Issue class, the add() method of the Book class is called. So, the books are added to book HashMap when the object of the Issue class is created.
Next, we will add more functionality to the Issue class.
